name: QSC_IMP_PROD_GROUP_REL
description: Interface table for product group relationships. Used for migrating product group hierarchies. The WHO columns in this table just reflects when the data was loaded into the interface table or when it was processed. These columns are for information purpose only and it will not be used during actual import into fusion.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Batch Identifier. Identifier that groups data into a batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Interface Row Id. Will be used to link this row with rows in the error table.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the row to be processed.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row such as Inserts, Updates etc.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: For Internal Use. Used to evaluate the operation to be performed on a row such as Insert, Update etc

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Product Group identifier in fusion base table.

columns.name: REL_CHILD_PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Related child product group identifier in fusion.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_REL_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Related Product Group Identifier in fusion product group relationship table.

columns.name: ADMIN_REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Used for internal processing. The revision number of the workspace version.

columns.name: RELATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Defines the relation type between product groups. For example - PRODUCT_GROUP_HIERARCHY, RELATED_SERVICE_GROUP

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Individual System Task Id  for each input csv file.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the specified language is also the source language.

columns.name: PROD_GRP_REL_NAME
columns.description: Translated Related Product Group Name.

columns.name: PG_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Parent product group reference number

columns.name: PG_REL_CHILD_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Child product group reference number

columns.name: PG_INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: Internal name of the parent product group

columns.name: PG_REL_CHILD_INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: Internal name of the child product group.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the related product group relationship is active.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the related product group relationship is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the related product group relationship is active

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER_NUM
columns.description: Manually set display order for related product groups in a product group.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Used by the file import wizard to relate a row in the interface table to the data file that was uploaded.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
